title: On the Optimal Co-location of Data Centers with Renewable Energy Sources in SIDS
summary: The rapid expansion of data centers presents both economic opportunities and systemic risks for Caribbean Small Island Developing States~(SIDS). This paper develops a PyPSA-based capacity expansion framework for optimal co-location of data centers with renewable energy infrastructure, incorporating behind-the-meter battery storage, workload flexibility (70\%/30\% inflexible/flexible split), and multi-bus transmission topology.
